subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and recovery ladder, and which recovery actions are allowed by default versus explicit opt-in?
rationale: The request adds new core recovery semantics, config surface, operator notifications, and security-boundary behavior that cannot be chosen safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep as design umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to settle the core design and review narrower PRs such as the watchdog service, health probe, doctor auto-fix, and crash ladder against that design.

options.title: Split to canonical slices
options.body: Move each remaining behavior to a narrower open issue and close this only after the broad security and product context is preserved there.

options.title: Reject core ownership
options.body: Document an external supervisor/plugin pattern instead of adding core watchdog semantics if maintainers decide this belongs outside OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Keep as design umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle the core design and review narrower PRs such as the watchdog service, health probe, doctor auto-fix, and crash ladder against that design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across the Gateway health, restart, startup recovery, and error-handling code paths implicated by the product decision.
